LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public online student ranking entry storing a student's name, course, school, and highest MultiDrop score.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase user UID owning this student entry.

studentName.description: Student display name shown on the online leaderboard (2-50 chars).

course.description: Student course or grade level (1-30 chars, e.g. 6° A).

school.description: Student school or institution name (2-80 chars).

bestScore.description: Highest score achieved by the student (0-10000000).

bestLevel.description: Level reached in the student's best run (1-999).

linesCleared.description: Rows cleared in the student's best run (0-100000).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the entry was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the entry was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

VersusMatch.title: VersusMatch
VersusMatch.description: Real-time 2-player versus match room where two players race to solve the same multiplicative target first across best-of-5 rounds.

hostUserId.description: UID of the player who created the versus room.

hostName.description: Display name of the host player (2-50 chars).

guestUserId.description: UID of the second player once joined.

guestName.description: Display name of the guest player (2-50 chars).

memberUids.description: Participant UIDs (1 while waiting, 2 when active).

totalRounds.description: Maximum number of rounds in the match (5).

hostWins.description: Rounds won by the host player (0-5).

guestWins.description: Rounds won by the guest player (0-5).

roundSeed.description: Shared deterministic seed for round board layouts.

targetArea.description: Shared multiplicative product target for the current round.

targetWidth.description: Target rectangle width factor for the current round.

targetHeight.description: Target rectangle height factor for the current round.

lastRoundWinnerUid.description: UID of the player who solved the most recent completed round first.

lastRoundWinnerName.description: Display name of the most recent round winner.

lastRoundSolveMs.description: Solve duration in milliseconds for the most recent round.

winnerUserId.description: UID of the overall match winner once finished.

winnerName.description: Display name of the overall match winner once finished.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the match was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the match was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

VersusRoundResult.title: VersusRoundResult
VersusRoundResult.description: Immutable record of a solved versus round written atomically when the first player completes the multiplicative target.

targetArea.description: Product target solved in this round.

winnerUserId.description: UID of the player who solved the round first.

winnerName.description: Display name of the round winner.

solveTimeMs.description: Time taken by the winner in milliseconds.

attempts.description: Placement attempts made by the winner in this round.

memberUids.description: Denormalized participant UIDs for subcollection read authorization.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the round result was recorded via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/leaderboard/{userId}.description: Online ranking of students by their highest score, showing name, course, and school.

/versus_matches/{matchId}.description: Real-time 2-player versus rooms and live match scoreboard state.

/versus_matches/{matchId}/rounds/{roundI.description: Per-round multiplicative race results recorded atomically via Firestore transactions.
